BULL2 (bull): Mean daily Intents volume rose from $24,132,777 in 2025 to $90,876,864 in 2026, a +276.57% change — nearly a 3.8x expansion of NEAR's Intents activity year over year. [figure 276.5703; 100 * (mean of intents_volume over 2026 / mean over 2025 - 1)]
BULL5 (bull): Mean daily transactions grew from 166,251 in 2021 to 6,593,296 in 2024, a +3865.87% change — roughly 39x scaling in three years. [figure 3865.8585; 100 * (mean of txns over 2024 / mean over 2021 - 1)]
BULL6 (bull): In the 7 days after the 2026-05-22 coverage of NEAR surging on the AI rally, price changed +63.62%, an 'up' verdict outside the ordinary band. [figure 63.6153; 100 * (mean of price over the 7 days from 2026-05-22 / mean over the 28 days before - 1)]

BULL8 (bull): In the 7 days after the 2022-01-12 announcement of NEAR Foundation's $150M raise, new accounts changed +2043.42%, an 'up' verdict outside the ordinary band. [figure 2043.4243; 100 * (mean of new_accounts over the 7 days from 2022-01-12 / mean over the 28 days before - 1)]
BULL9 (bull): The monthly mean price rose 360.816% from February 2026 to October 2026, showing a sharp recent recovery. [figure 360.8227; 100 * (mean of price over 2026-10 / mean over 2026-02 - 1)]

BULL11 (bull): The annual mean active accounts rose 834.514% from 2022 to 2023, so the 7-day decline after E015 was not sustained into the following year. [figure 834.5082; 100 * (mean of active_accounts over 2023 / mean over 2022 - 1)]
BEAR1 (bear): Price mean changed -61.345% from 2021 to 2026. [figure -61.3464; 100 * (mean of price over 2026 / mean over 2021 - 1)]
BEAR2 (bear): Active accounts mean changed -90.68% from 2024 to 2026. [figure -90.6795; 100 * (mean of active_accounts over 2026 / mean over 2024 - 1)]
BEAR3 (bear): 10 events moved_usage after 7 days. [figure 10.0; events stamped 'moved_usage' in the 7-day event test]
BEAR4 (bear): 6 events price_only after 7 days. [figure 6.0; events stamped 'price_only' in the 7-day event test]
BEAR5 (bear): Price changed -34.04% after E003. [figure -34.043; 100 * (mean of price over the 7 days from 2021-06-22 / mean over the 28 days before - 1)]
BEAR6 (bear): Active accounts changed -73.69% after E015. [figure -73.6936; 100 * (mean of active_accounts over the 7 days from 2022-03-24 / mean over the 28 days before - 1)]
